entries.title: Leviticus 12:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 12:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: 'If a woman has conceived, and borne a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her customary impurity she shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:3
segments: 'And on the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:4
segments: 'She shall then continue in the blood of [her] purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary until the days of her purification are fulfilled.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:5
segments: 'But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her customary impurity, and she shall continue in the blood of [her] purification sixty-six days.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:6
segments: ¶'When the days of her purification are fulfilled, whether for a son or a daughter, she shall bring to the priest a lamb of the first year as a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin offering, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:7
segments: 'Then he shall offer it before the LORD, and make atonement for her. And she shall be clean from the flow of her blood. This [is] the law for her who has borne a male or a female.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:8
segments: 'And if she is not able to bring a lamb, then she may bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons-one as a burnt offering and the other as a sin offering. So the priest shall make atonement for her, and she will be clean.'"
